sources.label: DigitalOcean Basic Droplet pricing
sources.evidence: 1 GiB, 1 vCPU, 25 GiB SSD, 1000 GiB transfer: USD 6.00/month

sources.label: AWS API Gateway WebSocket pricing
sources.evidence: US East example: USD 1.00/million metered messages and USD 0.25/million connection-minutes; 128 KiB message maximum and 32 KiB metering increments

self_host_example.assumptions: Single tenant, one region, no redundancy, taxes excluded, operator supplies domain/TLS/monitoring/backups/security response. Capacity is not proven by provider plan size; use measured RSS/CPU before selection.

aws_websocket_assumptions.one_mib_fragment_note: A 1 MiB relay envelope exceeds the 128 KiB API Gateway message maximum and must be split into at least eight transport messages; 32 metered 32 KiB units are modeled.

excluded_costs: Managed backend compute and state coordination
Internet data transfer and regional transfer
Monitoring, log ingestion, alerting, backups, and restore drills
High availability, DDoS/WAF, abuse handling, incident response, and on-call
Taxes, support plans, currency movement, and price changes
